$comment: Maps every row of docs/05-platform-delivery.md §2 (the Azure resource inventory) to the Bicep that implements it, and every §3.3 module to the row that owns it. The checker (infra/tools/check-infra.mjs) diffs this against the document in both directions: a row with no module is a gap, a module with no row is an undocumented resource. Labels are normalised by stripping bold markers and backticks and collapsing whitespace.
